options.content: Structured execution failures from persisted events: adapter/place/cancel failures, validation rejects, and sync failures. Use the tables to inspect exact exchange messages.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE e.event_type
    WHEN 'PlaceOrdersFailed' THEN 'place failed'
    WHEN 'CancelOrdersFailed' THEN 'cancel failed'
    WHEN 'OrderValidationRejected' THEN 'validation rejected'
    WHEN 'ExecutionSyncFailed' THEN 'sync failed'
    ELSE e.event_type
  END AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT
  e.exchange || ' ' ||
  CASE e.event_type
    WHEN 'PlaceOrdersFailed' THEN 'place failed'
    WHEN 'CancelOrdersFailed' THEN 'cancel failed'
    WHEN 'OrderValidationRejected' THEN 'validation rejected'
    WHEN 'ExecutionSyncFailed' THEN 'sync failed'
    ELSE e.event_type
  END AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || state.state AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  CROSS JOIN (
    VALUES ('place requested'), ('place accepted'), ('place failed'), ('cancel failed'), ('validation rejected'), ('sync failed')
  ) AS state(state)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM (
  SELECT e.ts,
         e.payload,
         e.event_type,
         CASE e.event_type
           WHEN 'PlaceOrdersRequested' THEN e.exchange || ' place requested'
           WHEN 'PlaceOrdersAccepted' THEN e.exchange || ' place accepted'
           WHEN 'PlaceOrdersFailed' THEN e.exchange || ' place failed'
           WHEN 'CancelOrdersFailed' THEN e.exchange || ' cancel failed'
           WHEN 'OrderValidationRejected' THEN e.exchange || ' validation rejected'
           ELSE e.exchange || ' sync failed'
         END AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersRequested', 'PlaceOrdersAccepted', 'PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
) e
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' unknown' AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  e.exchange || ' ' ||
  CASE
    WHEN e.event_type = 'OrderValidationRejected' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown')
    WHEN e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'ExecutionSyncFailed') THEN
      COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), 'unknown')
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  MAX(e.ts) AS last_seen,
  e.exchange,
  CASE e.event_type
    WHEN 'PlaceOrdersFailed' THEN 'place'
    WHEN 'CancelOrdersFailed' THEN 'cancel'
    WHEN 'OrderValidationRejected' THEN 'validation'
    WHEN 'ExecutionSyncFailed' THEN 'sync'
    ELSE e.event_type
  END AS operation,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown') AS error_or_reason,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'message', ''), NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown') AS message,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY count DESC, last_seen DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  e.ts,
  e.exchange,
  COALESCE(e.symbol, ord.value->>'symbol') AS symbol,
  e.event_type,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown') AS error_or_reason,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'message', ''), NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), '') AS message,
  COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', ord.value->>'side') AS side,
  COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', ord.value->>'price') AS price,
  COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ord.value->>'qty') AS qty
FROM mm_events e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[{}]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value) ON TRUE
WHERE e.event_type IN ('PlaceOrdersFailed', 'CancelOrdersFailed', 'OrderValidationRejected', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (
    e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR e.symbol IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord(value)
      WHERE ord.value->>'symbol' = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 200
